summary: std/json: a TokenReader resumes the scan of an unfinished string, number or literal where the last write stopped
details: a TokenReader resumes the scan of an unfinished string, number or literal where the last write stopped; it rescanned the token from its start on every write, quadratic in a long token sent in pieces (a 400 KB string in 64 byte writes: 584 ms, now under 1 ms). Tokens and errors are unchanged.
